needed.evidence: A grass verge with trees separates the carriageway from the buildings; there is no built path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a concrete footway on the left verge, separating it from the grass with a kerb.

needed.evidence: The left side of the road is a continuous strip of grass and planting with no usable path.
needed.suggestion: Install a paved footway on the left, using the existing grass strip as the build-out zone.

needed.evidence: The zebra crossing on the right leads from a flat, raised footway onto the road without any visible dropped kerb.
needed.suggestion: Cut the kerb into a ramp at the mouth of the zebra crossing to allow safe access from the footway.
